name: Skeleton
description: Use to show a placeholder while content is loading.

files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class Skeleton < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "skeleton"},
        class: "animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted"
      }
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Skeleton

Use to show a placeholder while content is loading.

## Usage

### Avatar

```ruby
div(class: "flex w-full items-center gap-4") do
  Skeleton(class: "size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full")
  div(class: "grid gap-2") do
    Skeleton(class: "h-4 w-[150px]")
    Skeleton(class: "h-4 w-[100px]")
  end
end
```

### Card

```ruby
Card(class: "w-full") do
  CardHeader do
    Skeleton(class: "h-4 w-2/3")
    Skeleton(class: "h-4 w-1/2")
  end
  CardContent do
    Skeleton(class: "aspect-square w-full")
  end
end
```

### Text

```ruby
div(class: "flex w-full flex-col gap-2") do
  Skeleton(class: "h-4 w-full")
  Skeleton(class: "h-4 w-full")
  Skeleton(class: "h-4 w-3/4")
end
```

### Form

```ruby
div(class: "flex w-full flex-col gap-7") do
  div(class: "flex flex-col gap-3") do
    Skeleton(class: "h-4 w-20")
    Skeleton(class: "h-10 w-full")
  end
  div(class: "flex flex-col gap-3") do
    Skeleton(class: "h-4 w-24")
    Skeleton(class: "h-10 w-full")
  end
  Skeleton(class: "h-9 w-24")
end
```

### Table

```ruby
div(class: "flex w-full flex-col gap-2") do
  3.times do
    div(class: "flex gap-4") do
      Skeleton(class: "h-4 flex-1")
      Skeleton(class: "h-4 w-24")
      Skeleton(class: "h-4 w-20")
    end
  end
end
```
